page_title: 7 Ways to Set Up a New Hire for Success

sources.entry: 7 Ways to Set Up a New Hire for Success

summary.title: 7 Ways to Set Up a New Hire for Success
summary.one_liner: Hiring managers can speed a new employee's ramp-up by addressing early challenges, building expertise, integrating them into the team, giving clear direction, and coaching them for several months.
keywords: getting new hires up to speed
takeaways: Hiring managers have the biggest impact on a new employee's success, so they should start supporting new hires early.
Understand the challenges of a new job, especially building peer relationships and adapting to a new organization.
Identify the technical, cultural and political expertise a new hire needs and connect them with resources.
Give clear direction on the what, how and why of tasks, set up early wins, and keep coaching for several months.
summary.summary: This Harvard Business Review article argues that hiring managers are best placed to shape new employees' success. It cites research that systematic onboarding brings new employees up to speed 50% faster. The piece, as described in the listed summary, lays out seven ways managers can help: understand early challenges, accelerate learning, make new hires feel part of the team, connect them with key stakeholders, give clear direction, set up early wins, and keep coaching over several months. The page text available here is mostly the summary and does not show the full seven points in detail.
